audit_items.proof_trace: The confidence check is correctly implemented in `assert_price_conf_within_range` (L94-95), which enforces `price_conf / price_value <= tolerance_bps / 10_000`. It is called from `ensure_price_ok` (L60) for both EMA and spot prices in `get_pyth_price` (L34-35), which is the sole Pyth price ingestion path. Tolerance bounds are validated at feed registration (L111-112), and `price_value` is guaranteed positive by `get_magnitude_if_positive()` before reaching the check.
